falsifier_requirement.trigger: source-lock declaration contains observed target values, predictions, residuals, or row hashes; formula selection uses heldout target rows or non-prior validation rows; any comparator beats or ties the selected model within uncertainty/materiality policy; target mutation fails to change the candidate-pack or row hash; official source snapshot hash changes between acquisition and replay

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: select, using only years earlier than heldout_year, the lowest prior validation residual among carry_forward, linear_last_slope, damped_slope_25/50/75, rolling_mean_3/5, rolling_slope_3/5, and simple exponential smoothing; then score the heldout target once

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: WGI governance best-of carry-forward, prior-mean, and trailing-mean comparators
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: score each heldout target against preregistered last-observation carry-forward, prior-training mean, and trailing-three-year mean baselines on the same source snapshot
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Implement or repair the exact domain scorer until the downstream scoring artifact passes or remains honestly fail-closed with a narrower research blocker.

required_source_block.source_authority: World Bank World Development Indicators API
required_source_block.source_name: World Bank World Development Indicators API

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual per heldout country/indicator/year; aggregate mean absolute residual
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: every row and aggregate residual margin must exceed preregistered materiality thresholds

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual per heldout country/indicator/year; aggregate mean absolute residual
uncertainty_requirement.rule: selected-formula prior validation residual envelope declared before target unsealing

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
